title: Rings on contrasting photographic fields

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Adjust a signature to its image context so people can identify the same brand across contrasting scenes.
strategic_value: White rings over the dark vehicle scene and black rings beside the portrait can maintain Audi recognition without one fixed background.
demonstration: A vertical split pairs a frontal car photograph with white rings at upper left and a bright portrait with black rings and myAudi below.
practical_value: Compare positive and reversed signatures against the actual lightness of their photographic surroundings.

content_islands.name: Vehicle panel
content_islands.spec: Place the front-facing car within a dark architectural photograph on the left, with white rings above.

content_islands.name: Portrait panel
content_islands.spec: Use a bright close-up on the right, placing black rings and myAudi beside the face.

reference_purposes.Expression: The two halves reverse the ring color while retaining the same recognizable form.
reference_purposes.Application: The side-by-side example places the signature in vehicle and myAudi contexts.
